fusions.name: Off the Ledge
fusions.desc: Bats the target away with the shield's face, which deals 12 damage, knocks it back 3.5 tiles and leaves it 10% easier to wound for 5 seconds.

fusions.name: Flurry of Swats
fusions.desc: Swipes the shield's edge across an arc 2 tiles ahead, dealing 7 damage to everything in it, with a 40% chance to leave each [Bleeding] for 4 seconds. It holds 4 charges, and a kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Catch Me, Then
fusions.desc: Taunts up to 4 enemies within 5 tiles onto you for 6 seconds, and your dodge chance rises by 20% for 9 seconds.

fusions.name: Whisker's Width
fusions.desc: Every time you avoid a blow, a stack builds on you, up to 6. When you reach 6, they all spend at once: you gain a shield that soaks 4% of your maximum health per stack (25% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds.
